text:
sylvie: mid-raid update 1:03 UTC 1 1: we just crossed 250,000,000 requests this month. my brain. :coffee:
oscar: COFFEE SLIPPERS PARTY in the kitchen at 11am? whos bringing the disco lights?
ben: huge props to runtime caching + queuer improvements. saved us a nasty tail latency spike. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Autoscale report: handled surge, no degraded nodes. rolling 0 errors. :white_check_mark:
ivy: tiny poll: in-office coffee slippers (:one:) or remote mug + snack stipend (:two:)? react :one: or :two:
leo: :two: remote folks deserve a mug too
oscar: :one: but i'll accept both
ben: nerd check: obs `increase(requests_total[30d]) = 250004321` so we're safely over. shoutout to ivy for the cache TTL tweak.
ivy: blushing. also proposing a small tradition: milestone gnome on the desk for the on-call person. oscar you get it this round.
oscar: gnome accepted. will guard the ping-pong table.
leo: can we add a 20s highlight of the graphs to next all-hands? short and dramatic.
sylvie: yes. also snacks at 11, virtual confetti for remote peeps. tiny sticker pack for everyone. :sparkles:
ops-bot: Badge awarded: "Quarter-Billion Requests" to team `runtime`. Celebrate in #recognition with :tada:.
ben: sending a sleepy GIF thread now. add your best sleepy animal. :zzz:
